snippet.title: Idle Pop Steam Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Idle Pop on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5563720

🎈 
A cozy balloon idler that lives on your desktop. Pop balloons beside your work while Poppie bops along, unleash wild toys for huge combos, play carnival minigames, climb 14 skies to Outer Space, and collect tradable Balloon Pals.
🎈 

#IdlePop #IndieGame #CozyGame
